views.name: seller_performance_metrics
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    oi.seller_id,
    SUM(oi.price) AS total_sales,
    AVG(oi.price) AS avg_item_price,
    AVG(rev.review_score) AS avg_review_score,
    AVG(julianday(o.order_delivered_carrier_date) - julianday(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS avg_packing_time,
    COUNT(oi.product_id) AS products_sold_count
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN order_reviews rev ON o.order_id = rev.order_id
GROUP BY oi.seller_id
views.description: aggregates transaction-level records per seller to compute total revenue, average item price, average review score, and average packing time, along with the total count of products sold.

views.name: seller_category_ranking
views.body_sql: SELECT oi.seller_id, pct.product_category_name_english AS category_name_en, SUM(oi.price) AS category_sales_volume, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY oi.seller_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.price) DESC) AS category_rank FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name GROUP BY oi.seller_id, pct.product_category_name_english
views.description: ranks product categories by total sales volume per seller to identify the highest-selling category for each vendor.
